_comment: PHASE 5 — sirf ITNE packages add karne hain. Apna pura package.json mat replace kar.
_why_not_jsonwebtoken: jsonwebtoken Edge Runtime (middleware) me crash karta hai kyunki wo Node ka crypto module maangta hai. jose same HS256 JWT deta hai aur Edge + Node dono par chalta hai. Agar tu jsonwebtoken bhi rakhna chahta hai to rakh sakta hai — par middleware me jose hi use hoga.
